notes: Community plug-in registry for J-Log. Each entry points at a JSON file the j-hub web UI can fetch and drop into ~/.j-log/plugins/ (contests) or ~/.j-log/awards/ with one click. v2 (2026-05-16): added the full bundled QSO-party suite — 46 US/Canada state, provincial, multi-state and club QSO parties built/validated against the sponsors' official rules over 2026-05-15..16 (engine commits b324f79..ffd5104). Each is also bundled inside j-log-engine.jar; the registry entry provides discoverability and lets users pull updates. Submissions: open a PR adding your plug-in to this file. Plug-ins must follow the schemas documented in docs/PLUGINS.md.
